title: Keyboard Manager Breaks When Mapping Win+V

status.label: Clarify the Win+V remap and current behavior
status.detail: The report lists PowerToys 0.97.2 and says mapping an unspecified key sequence to Win+V makes the clipboard-history window blink closed. The source mapping and current-build behavior are not provided.

judgment.rationale: The report says that mapping “any set of keys” to send Win+V makes the Clipboard History popup blink, but does not identify the source chord, whether Win is already part of it, or the exact saved action. The issue lists PowerToys 0.97.2 and has no comments or current-build retest. Ask for the exact mapping and a controlled current-build result before attributing the behavior to shortcut injection or Clipboard History.
evidence: The report says a remapped key sequence that sends Win+V opens the Clipboard History window briefly and then it closes.
The source chord, mapping mode, and whether the failure occurs after switching layouts or with other mappings are unspecified.
The issue is open with no comments or assignee.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for the exact source-to-Win+V mapping and a current-build retest; request /bugreport only if the controlled test still blinks closed.

fix_assessment.rationale: The issue does not identify the source chord or mapping mode and is reported on 0.97.2. A current reproduction is needed to identify whether the popup closes due to the configured sequence, a layout/modifier interaction, or a change already fixed.

issue_context.summary: A Keyboard Manager mapping to Win+V reportedly opens then immediately closes the Windows Clipboard History popup.
known_information: The issue lists PowerToys 0.97.2 and says the target is Win+V.
The reporter describes the popup blinking but does not identify the exact source chord or mapping mode.
There are no comments, assignees, or current-build tests.
inferences: The source mapping may overlap with Win or include modifiers whose release affects the popup, but the issue does not establish that mechanism.
issue_context.analysis: A controlled retest needs the exact source-to-target mapping and observation of the popup after all remapped keys are released. Without those details, the issue cannot distinguish a shortcut mapping problem from expected behavior of the Windows overlay.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body and confirmed it has no discussion or assignee.
The report does not provide the source sequence, mapping mode, or current version result.

information_gaps.how_to_collect: Describe or screenshot only the affected Keyboard Manager row.

information_gaps.information: Whether the same mapping still causes the popup to close on PowerToys 0.100.2 or newer.

information_gaps.how_to_collect: Retest the exact source-to-Win+V mapping on the current build and note whether the popup remains open after the source keys are released.

information_gaps.information: A fresh diagnostic archive only if the current-build popup still closes immediately.

comment.body:
Thanks for the report. It lists PowerToys 0.97.2 and says a remap to Win+V opens Clipboard History briefly, but it does not identify the source chord. Could you please:
1. Share the exact Keyboard Manager source-to-target row and say whether the source chord includes Win.
2. Retest that exact mapping on PowerToys 0.100.2 or newer and report whether the Clipboard History window stays open after releasing the source keys.
3. If it still closes immediately, comment `/bugreport` right after reproducing.
This will help distinguish a current remap issue from an interaction specific to the source modifiers.
